description_excerpt: Job Description The Senior Engineer - Data Science & Analytics is responsible for developing and implementing data-driven solutions to address complex business and technical requirements. Main Roles and Responsibilities • Develop statistical models and machine learning algorithms to identify trends, patterns, and correlations in large-scale datasets as per communication and alignment with customer or customer interface.…
